description.zh: 参数名称。取值范围：内容限制为字母、数字、中划线、下划线，长度不能超过180字符，且不能以aliyun、acs、alibaba、alicloud、oos开头。
description.en: The name of the parameter. The name can be up to 180 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The name cannot start with aliyun, acs, alibaba, alicloud, or oos.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos delete-parameter --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name MyParameter --region cn-hangzhou
